topics.name: Active sensing and target tracking
topics.summary: Motion planners and acoustic trackers handle sparse, uncertain observations while preserving coverage. Candidate-set updates, Bayesian filtering, and hydrophone measurements guide trajectory choice and multi-vehicle tracking.

topics.name: Learning-based robotic manipulation
topics.summary: These papers improve contact-rich manipulation with action-level safety filters, flow or entropy-regularized policies, tactile and visual feedback, and simulated or physical data. Results emphasize safer execution, dexterity, and transfer across embodiments.

topics.name: Robot navigation, exploration, and mapping
topics.summary: Navigation systems combine semantic cues, temporal map fusion, uncertainty-aware exploration, and learned state representations. Indoor, unknown-space, and social-navigation tests measure coverage, efficiency, robustness, and interaction quality.

topics.name: Ultrasound and inertial sensing for robotics
topics.summary: Wearable ultrasound and inertial-encoder filtering recover hand or manipulator kinematics for embodied control. The methods emphasize compact sensing, geometric state estimation, and operation despite motion or changing configurations.

topics.name: Reconfigurable rolling robots
topics.summary: Mechanical studies develop rolling platforms using compliant joints, pendulum actuation, magnetic coupling, and adjustable stiffness. Experiments relate deformation and internal layout to turning, support, and coordinated locomotion.

topics.name: IoT and edge automation
topics.summary: Device-management systems use structured commands, graph-based conflict resolution, preprocessing, and ROS or MQTT links across smart-home, safety, edge, and greenhouse deployments. The recurring goal is dependable action across heterogeneous devices.

topics.name: Learning-based driving and roadside safety
topics.summary: Driving studies combine audio-visual and event sensing with scene complexity, early kinematics, trajectory context, and risk-aware language. Evaluations focus on difficult roadside events, braking behavior, and situation-specific intervention quality.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning for language-model reasoning
topics.summary: Training studies vary data schedules, curricula, reward gates, and distillation weights to improve reasoning efficiency. Analyses connect token position, update quality, parameter-space movement, and code-compliance performance under reinforcement learning.

topics.name: Efficient language-model inference
topics.summary: Serving and architecture work combines geometric scheduling, decoder calibration, and automated mixture-of-experts search. The methods target better throughput, lower latency, and more reliable allocation of computation across models and requests.

topics.name: Agent memory and skill management
topics.summary: Agent architectures organize codebase knowledge, reusable skills, and episodic robot experience under interference. Retrieval, hypothesis testing, and structured indexes aim to preserve useful behavior while limiting distraction and regressions.

topics.name: Planning and orchestration for tool-using agents
topics.summary: Hierarchical policies, programmatic market strategies, tool-use benchmarks, symbolic workflows, deterministic environments, and research or design loops provide explicit control over long tasks. Evaluation emphasizes recoverability, convergence, and verifiable intermediate actions.

topics.name: AI agent governance and capability control
topics.summary: Safety studies examine incompatible instructions, graduated oversight, revocable permissions, and loss of constraints during context compression. The proposed controls connect policy requirements with concrete limits on coding-agent actions and authority.

topics.name: LLM alignment and safety robustness
topics.summary: Mechanistic probes and stress tests study internal conflict, prompt-injection detection, safety steering, alignment fragility, and refusal behavior. Hidden-state geometry and calibrated uncertainty reveal where safeguards degrade or can be redirected.

topics.name: Evaluation of language models and AI agents
topics.summary: Benchmarks and empirical audits measure multilingual judging, desktop and coding-agent work, engineering discipline, co-authorship effects, peer-review claims, cultural values, and emergent collective behavior. The studies stress confounding, process quality, and context-dependent outcomes.

topics.name: Grounded retrieval and factual verification
topics.summary: Knowledge graphs, risk-sensitive claim checking, delta-based retrieval, and health-domain graph systems allocate evidence where it matters most. The papers report improved factual support, reduced redundant searching, and more inspectable answers.

topics.name: Causal modeling for scientific discovery
topics.summary: These works infer difference-making relations in text, evolving embodied world models, research trajectories, and federated intervention systems. Causal structure is used for explanation, policy evaluation, and synchronization rather than prediction alone.

topics.name: Mechanistic interpretability of transformers
topics.summary: Transformer analyses trace routing collapse, language-identity signals, behavioral subspaces, and asymptotic attention representations. Interventions and signal-recovery arguments clarify how information is distributed and how model behavior can be steered.

topics.name: LLM applications in education, culture, and creative media
topics.summary: Language-centered applications span code authorship obfuscation, tutoring interventions, human-robot conceptual alignment, story and music generation, tutor feedback, evolving datasets, and symbolic music editing. Structured prompts and representations make behavior measurable or steerable.

topics.name: Multilingual and low-resource language technology
topics.summary: Low-resource systems study vocabulary expansion, continued pretraining, sign-language translation, Portuguese evaluation, and quantization across scripts. Results expose trade-offs among tokenizer coverage, cultural or linguistic transfer, context, and compressed-model quality.

topics.name: Parameter-efficient model adaptation
topics.summary: Adaptation methods use reliability weighting, hyperedge or prompt modules, task routing, model merging, and orthogonal representation edits. They seek useful transfer with limited updates, less interference, and better control under few-shot or heterogeneous tasks.

topics.name: Multimodal forensics and deception detection
topics.summary: Document tampering, contextual image-text manipulation, conversational-agent fingerprinting, and private video deception detection use discrepancy features, interaction traces, compact on-device descriptors, and cross-encoder scoring. The applications prioritize attribution and privacy alongside accuracy.

topics.name: Clinical medical imaging
topics.summary: Clinical imaging systems address ultrasound segmentation and frame selection, CT or MRI diagnosis, pulmonary risk assessment, nodule annotation, epilepsy localization, and histology classification. Transfer learning, self-supervision, collaboration, and calibrated boundaries support external or multi-center use.

topics.name: Clinical data curation and health knowledge systems
topics.summary: Clinical pipelines clean report-derived labels and organize multidisciplinary tumor-board evidence in graph-oriented systems. The recurring emphasis is traceable data preparation and structured decision support rather than isolated image prediction.

topics.name: Medical anomaly and out-of-distribution detection
topics.summary: Training-free medical detectors compare hierarchical visual features or residual distances against reference distributions. Their evaluations target reliable anomaly discovery across modalities and acquisition conditions without extensive task-specific labeling.

topics.name: Robust perception under distribution shift
topics.summary: Robustness methods address adversarial transfer, unfamiliar objects, synthetic lighting, document degradation, facial-expression ambiguity, and multipath RF sensing. Input diversity, physical constraints, uncertainty routing, and domain-incremental learning improve cross-environment behavior.

topics.name: Fine-grained and long-tailed video understanding
topics.summary: Video models target subtle actions, rare categories, and sign-language gestures using self-guided visual reasoning, generative balancing, and transformer encoders. Results are measured on action and sign-video datasets with attention to scarce classes and confusable labels.

topics.name: Multimodal vision benchmarks and explainability
topics.summary: Evaluation resources cover general multimodal reasoning, microscopy images, and a fully inspectable differentiable Atari environment. They provide controlled visual evidence or known internal ground truth for testing fine-grained understanding and explanation methods.

topics.name: Multimodal spatial reasoning and geolocation
topics.summary: Cross-view geolocation, street-map decisions, autonomous-vehicle geometry, and multi-perspective grounding combine camera relations, map structure, projection cues, and symbolic composition. Benchmarks show that explicit spatial representations help with viewpoint changes and relational depth.

topics.name: Visual tracking and temporal scene understanding
topics.summary: Tracking systems combine complementary estimators or worldline-centered language representations to maintain identity and geometry over time. Their tests address occlusion, motion, multiple views, and changing scene context.

topics.name: Controllable visual recognition and segmentation
topics.summary: The methods make visual explanations or segmentation more controllable through learned attribution paths, failure-aware retrieval, promptable diffusion, and modular recognition. Experiments cover instance, referring, and structured visual tasks.

topics.name: Consistent and controllable visual generation
topics.summary: Image and video generators address identity drift, repeated transformations, physical plausibility, semantic trajectory editing, and long-duration coherence. Manifold alignment, identity-action separation, intermediate correction, and semantic conditioning improve stability across extended generation.

topics.name: Efficient video generation and avatar rendering
topics.summary: Video deployment work combines relightable human avatars, generative compression, and hardware-aware caching, sparsity, quantization, and kernel selection. The shared objective is usable visual quality under resource and platform constraints.

topics.name: Flow-based inference and 3D reconstruction
topics.summary: Flow-based methods adapt trajectories or posterior corrections for inverse problems, consistency distillation, sparse-view tomography, and one-step reconstruction. Structural diagnostics and learned schedules reduce computation while protecting geometry and uncertainty.

topics.name: 3D vision, graphics, and geometric measurement
topics.summary: These systems estimate curved object dimensions or edit appearance using RGB-D geometry, neural UV parameterization, projection-aware synthesis, radiance-field transfer, and learned lighting. Evaluation emphasizes physical alignment, surface fidelity, and measurement accuracy.

topics.name: Generative robustness and uncertainty
topics.summary: Generative models represent uncertainty with calibrated latent sets or weighted denoising objectives. Production-planning and facility-location studies, together with contaminated-data experiments, assess expressiveness, robustness, verification cost, and solution quality.

topics.name: Protein, molecular, and drug discovery
topics.summary: Biomolecular studies improve protein features, multiresolution molecular generation, crystal-search environments, quantum protein classification, and DNA-encoded library design. Structural priors, graph or voxel representations, and computational screening support discovery under limited experimental budgets.

topics.name: Quantum machine learning
topics.summary: Quantum learning methods study prototype construction, hyperdimensional binding, measurement rescaling, and generalization under noisy or limited reference settings. The recurring concerns are trainability, stability, and useful classification signals.

topics.name: Materials modeling and scientific design
topics.summary: Materials and photonic design systems combine process-structure-property reasoning, learned composite homogenization, and solver-validated agentic search. Graph evidence and deterministic physics checks help connect candidate generation with reliable engineering outcomes.

topics.name: Optimization theory for machine learning
topics.summary: Theoretical analyses address Adam under nonsmooth nonconvex losses, local learning-coefficient estimation away from equilibrium, and structural limits of double machine learning. The results provide convergence or admissibility guidance when smoothness and model assumptions fail.

topics.name: Stochastic optimization and adaptive inference
topics.summary: These methods control variance, tails, and unknown scales in conformal selection, bilevel root finding, robust stochastic updates, contextual bandits, and adaptive procedures. Guarantees target stable estimation or near-optimal behavior under misspecification and non-Gaussian noise.

topics.name: Game theory and strategic network formation
topics.summary: Strategic-learning studies analyze robust mean-field games, preference alignment, running-reference self-play, and information-sharing network formation. Averaging, Markov structure, shared costs, and model mismatch shape equilibrium stability and last-iterate behavior.

topics.name: Graph foundation models
topics.summary: Graph learners generate task-adapted low-rank parameters or perform recurrent test-time computation over message-passing states. Both approaches seek reusable structure and efficient adaptation across graph prediction tasks.

topics.name: Document understanding and structured information extraction
topics.summary: The systems extract relations from general and historical text, recognize cuneiform signs, and predict outcomes from consumer complaint narratives. OCR, compact language models, topic features, and structured attributes improve searchable and decision-oriented representations.

topics.name: Speech and audio processing
topics.summary: Audio research covers speaker verification infrastructure, multilingual diarization, adaptive room equalization, self-supervised speech enhancement, and latent speech-text computation. The methods combine signal processing, pretrained representations, and cross-modal analysis for noisy or low-resource settings.

topics.name: Neuromorphic and physical neural computing
topics.summary: Hardware studies implement analog or stochastic neural operations with resistive crossbars, programmable plasticity, sensing, and trainable nonlinear devices. Device-aware modeling connects circuit behavior with local learning, energy use, and continuous-control workloads.

topics.name: Federated learning under heterogeneity and attacks
topics.summary: Federated methods address noisy communication, climate forecasting, backdoor removal, and heterogeneous low-rank updates without centralizing raw data. Variance reduction, unlearning, and subspace constraints improve aggregation reliability and resilience.

topics.name: Time-series forecasting and dynamical systems
topics.summary: Temporal models cover stellar flares, chaotic attractors, and macroeconomic factor ranking using Gaussian-process inference, recurrent comparisons, retrieval, and leakage-controlled evaluation. The studies balance predictive signal against stability, observability, and statistical uncertainty.

topics.name: Software assurance, testing, and vulnerability repair
topics.summary: Software assurance combines end-to-end web verification, metamorphic checks for encrypted computation, cross-weakness intrusion detection, and retrieval-assisted patching. The common focus is semantic failures and cross-case generalization beyond ordinary unit tests.

topics.name: Grammar-constrained code generation
topics.summary: Domain-specific code generation improves when prompts provide grammar, APIs, and restricted vocabularies, with syntax trees and runtime checks filtering invalid outputs. Controlled distillation and ablations separate semantic quality from formal validity.

topics.name: Representation learning and visual optimization
topics.summary: These studies connect compact feature structure with sparse dictionary activation, reconstruction-storage trade-offs, super-resolution objective conflict, and entropy-based image descriptors. Generative interpretations and shared representations improve interpretability or visual fidelity under constrained computation.
